description: This file defines interfaces, enums, and classes related to asynchronous enumeration requests in the Orleans runtime, including request handling, enumeration result types, and proxy implementations for async enumeration over distributed grains.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerableRequest`1
classes.description: Abstract base class for asynchronous enumerable requests, providing mechanisms for invoking and initializing async enumeration over distributed grains.

classes.name: AsyncEnumeratorProxy`1
classes.description: Proxy implementation for managing async enumeration lifecycle, including starting enumeration, moving to next element, and disposal.

classes.name: EnumerationAbortedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that enumeration has been aborted, typically due to remote errors or deactivation.

methods.name: InitializeRequest
methods.description: Initializes the request with a target grain reference.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; direct invocation is not supported for IAsyncEnumerable requests.

methods.name: InvokeImplementation
methods.description: Returns the inner async enumerable implementation.

methods.name: GetAsyncEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an async enumerator proxy for iterating over the results.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes the async enumerator, notifying the remote grain and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: MoveNextAsync
methods.description: Advances the enumerator to the next element, handling various enumeration result states.
